name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label in ink, shown on hover, focus and long press.
use: A few words that name a control or show its shortcut. It adds to the control's accessible name and does not replace it: an icon-only button keeps its aria-label. Nothing in a tooltip can be clicked, and a touch screen shows it only on a long press, so nothing may be available in a tooltip alone.

instead.when: The content has a link, a form or anything else a reader acts on, or is a preview longer than a few words
It explains a form field and should stay visible
It reports something that just happened

keyboard.action: Focus on the control shows its tooltip after a short delay, as hover does
Hide the tooltip; focus stays on the control

platform.feature: popover="hint" with interestfor on the control (interest invokers)
platform.fallback: The tooltip does not appear and the control keeps its accessible name. To show it there, call showPopover() and hidePopover() from pointer and focus handlers; the stylesheet is the same
The tooltip appears centered in the viewport, where the browser places any popover
The tooltip appears and leaves at once, without the fade

classes.name: tooltip
classes.description: The label, on an element with popover="hint"; without the popover attribute it is never shown. It sits centered above its control at a distance of --anchored-gap (6px), flips below when there is no room, and wraps at 16rem. A kbd inside reads on the ink surface without a variant

classes.name: tooltip-bottom
classes.description: Prefers the space below the control, for controls in a top bar

properties.name: --anchored-gap
properties.description: Space between the surface and the control that opened it; 6px when not set

example: Ships the main branch to production
